title: Nine Parts Affection
subtitle: 纽带与联结 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 纽带与联结（社会服务与人际沟通·情感与关系）
meta: 主题语境：纽带与联结（社会服务与人际沟通·情感与关系）　|　核心词汇：bond　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bond 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my mother was sent to repair ① a bond she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② bond, meaning the tie and not the money, was nine years old and was kept by whoever came last; a bond, she said, is the only thing in a family that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bond in that folder had the same signature, and the ④ bond at the front, meaning the one the lawyer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever read properly. A bond, my grandmother said, is nine parts affection and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the affection is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bond was the whole of the family, meaning the affection and not the paper. The ⑥ bond, meaning the affection and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody inherits and nobody questions; a bond, he said, is either something you repair or the only word that means both a tie and a promise. She said the family is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ bond had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the money. The ⑧ bond of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years of affection and eleven years of reading; a bond, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bond I remember is the one at the front, which was copied in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bond, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being kept; every bond, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like a paper. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 纽带（指关系本身，与钱、契约相对）
C. 固定搭配：repair a bond 修复一段关系
D. n. 契约；债券（指文件夹里每一份）
E. n. 契约；债券（指前面那一份）
F. n. 情谊；情分（抽象：与纸面契约相对）
G. n. 情谊（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bond she could not name
The bond, meaning the tie and not the money
bond was the whole of the family
the bond had become a number in a report
The bond of the whole thing
A bond, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: repair a bond 意为“修复一段关系”，1958 年母亲被派去修复一段她说不出名字的关系。
bond 意为“纽带”，指关系本身而不是钱，维系了九年，由最后走的人守着。
bond 指文件夹里每一份契约，每一份都是同样的签名。
bond 指前面那一份（律师留的那一份），是唯一有人认真读过的。
bond 意为“情谊、情分”，与纸面契约相对，父亲说 bond 就是那个家的全部。
bond 为抽象用法，指那份情谊本身，是屋子里人人都继承、却没人质疑的东西。
bond 意为“纽带、联结”，此处指那一份契约，到 1972 年成了报告里的一个数字。
bond 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的情分与十一年的阅读。
bond 意为“契约、纽带”，我记得的是前面那一份，1977 年被抄录，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bond 为抽象总称，祖母说情谊是唯一会因为被守住而变好的东西。
